title: Zak's Sword
description: This is a mod that adds a sword made of stoned diamond.
body:
> Mod: A modification that currently adds only one sword with 25 damage, its crafting, and a villager trade for the sword

> Craft: Currently, its crafting consists of a new ore - Stoned Diamond, any log, redstone, and a netherite ingot.

> Trade: The Sword costs 60 emeralds and is unlocked at Expert level.

> Ore: The ore can only be mined with a Diamond or Netherite pickaxe.

P.S.
Don't be too hard on me, as this is my first mod.
And I wrote this using Google Translate, so there may be grammatical errors in the text.
